A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
